p.n: The Philosopher Responds that Emotions Change

body.p:
and so a man of reason creates for every such instance a judgment and prepares
resources for that accordingly, when he covets that which the enemy has to offer after being disappointed at what the friend couldn’t offer].
A man

p.n: Enmity Must Not Stop One from Requesting Help

body.p:
of reason is not hindered by an enmity in his soul toward his enemy from approaching him, soliciting
aid, if he desires him to help avert a scary matter or draw benefit; so he applies judgment in bringing
connection and reconciliation.

He who employs his judgment on this and acts with diligence will thereby attain
his need and emerge from his predicament.

p.n: The Parable of the Cat and Rat Is Invoked

body.p:
An example of this isthe parable of
the rat and the cat, who put their disagreements aside when they fell into trouble and difficulty, and wherewith
came deliverance for them both from what they had fallen into.”
